# llü

> llü is the dance music project of Luis Palomares, who writes and produces the songs and draws their art. The site, https://7thst.music, is in Spanish first, with English at https://7thst.music/?lang=en.

## Buena Suerte

The new record: nine songs dealt like a Lotería deck, one card each. On the site a card is drawn at a time and the room takes the color of its painted world. The cards that are out play in full; the ones still to come are sealed and play a 30-second preview ("probadita") until they come out in early 2027.

- 1. La Luna: out now, 4:04
- 2. El Cotorro: out now, 3:09
- 3. El Diablito: out now, 4:19
- 4. El Sueño: sealed, 30-second preview on the site, out in full in early 2027
- 5. Los Amigos: sealed, 30-second preview on the site, out in full in early 2027
- 6. El Corazón: sealed, 30-second preview on the site, out in full in early 2027
- 7. El Fuego: sealed, 30-second preview on the site, out in full in early 2027
- 8. El Perdido: sealed, 30-second preview on the site, out in full in early 2027
- 9. La Dama: sealed, 30-second preview on the site, out in full in early 2027

## Art

[Mis dibujos / My art](https://7thst.music/art.html): covers (portadas, 11), dreams (sueños, 38), mandalas (34), voices (voces, 4), animals (animales, 2).

## La Máquina

A terminal behind the deck, at https://7thst.music/maquina/, where anyone can write techno in a few lines of code and hear it right away. It runs on [Strudel](https://strudel.cc), the browser version of TidalCycles, with classic drum machines and synths; llü's own sounds and dark techno are coming. Patterns can be shared as links.

## From the studio

- [Arreglo](https://arreglo.ai): an AI-powered music arrangement generator for Figma, by 7thSt.music and llü.
